items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I helped start him off ... bringing him on to introduce modern jazz -- Bebop -- to the public. ... when Diz heard Parker, and Parker heard Diz... I was a part of fate, you might say, bringin em together
